select a.id, case a.financing_type when 'DIRECT' then c.product_name else b.organization_name end as financingName, case a.financing_type when 'DIRECT' then c.financing_amount else b.financing_amount end as financingAmount, case a.financing_type when 'DIRECT' then c.financing_code else b.financing_code end as financingCode, a.financing_id as financingId from fund_receipt_repay_base_info as a left join fund_financing_base_info as b on a.financing_id = b.id and a.financing_type is null left join fund_direct_financing_base_info as c on a.financing_id = c.id and a.financing_type = 'DIRECT' where 1 = 1
financingName like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
mapper.sql:
select 0 as is_direct, concat('INDIRECT@REPAY@', b.id, '@', a.id) as identifier, b.id, b.financing_amount, a.write_off_state, case a.write_off_state when 'NO_WRITE_OFF' then 10 when 'WRITE_OFF_ING' then 20 when 'PART_WRITE_OFF' then 30 when 'WRITTEN_OFF' then 40 else 100 end as flow_sort_no, 'REPAY' as cash_flow_item, a.cash_flow_code, a.repay_amount as plan_cash_flow_amount, a.principle_amount as plan_principal_amount, a.interest_amount as plan_interest_amount, a.phase, a.repay_date as plan_cash_flow_date, c.id as financing_id, c.financing_code as financing_code, org.organization_name as fund_channel, c.business_type as biz_type from fund_receipt_repay_cash_flow as a inner join fund_receipt_repay_base_info as b on a.receipt_repay_id = b.id and b.financing_type is null inner join fund_financing_base_info as c on b.financing_id = c.id left join ( select a.financing_id,a.organization_id as organization_id from fund_financing_credit_ref a join (select min(id) min_id,financing_id from fund_financing_credit_ref group by financing_id) as minTable on minTable.min_id = a.id ) as ref on c.id = ref.financing_id left join fund_organization org on org.id = ref.organization_id
union select 1 as is_direct, concat('DIRECT@REPAY@', b.id, '@', a.id) as identifier, b.id, b.financing_amount, a.write_off_state, case a.write_off_state when 'NO_WRITE_OFF' then 10 when 'WRITE_OFF_ING' then 20 when 'PART_WRITE_OFF' then 30 when 'WRITTEN_OFF' then 40 else 100 end as flow_sort_no, 'REPAY' as cash_flow_item, a.cash_flow_code, a.repay_amount as plan_cash_flow_amount, a.principle_amount as plan_principal_amount, a.interest_amount as plan_interest_amount, a.phase, a.repay_date as plan_cash_flow_date, c.id as financing_id, c.financing_code as financing_code, c.product_name as fund_channel, c.direct_financing_type as biz_type from fund_receipt_repay_cash_flow as a inner join fund_receipt_repay_base_info as b on a.receipt_repay_id = b.id and b.financing_type = 'DIRECT' inner join fund_direct_financing_base_info as c on b.financing_id = c.id union select 0 as is_direct, concat('INDIRECT@DEPOSIT_PAYMENT@', b.id, '@', a.id) as identifier, b.id, b.financing_amount, a.write_off_state, case a.write_off_state when 'NO_WRITE_OFF' then 10 when 'WRITE_OFF_ING' then 20 when 'PART_WRITE_OFF' then 30 when 'WRITTEN_OFF' then 40 else 100 end as flow_sort_no, 'DEPOSIT_PAYMENT' as cash_flow_item, a.cash_flow_code, a.amount as plan_cash_flow_amount, null, null, null, c.actual_loan_date as plan_cash_flow_date, c.id as financing_id, c.financing_code as financing_code, org.organization_name as fund_channel, c.business_type as biz_type from fund_receipt_repay_cash_deposit as a inner join fund_receipt_repay_base_info as b on a.receipt_repay_id = b.id and b.financing_type is null inner join fund_financing_base_info as c on b.financing_id = c.id left join ( select a.financing_id,a.organization_id as organization_id from fund_financing_credit_ref a join (select min(id) min_id,financing_id from fund_financing_credit_ref group by financing_id) as minTable on minTable.min_id = a.id ) as ref on c.id = ref.financing_id left join fund_organization org on org.id = ref.organization_id where a.deposit_cash_flow_type = 'DEPOSIT_PAYMENT' union select 1 as is_direct, concat('DIRECT@DEPOSIT_PAYMENT@', b.id, '@', a.id) as identifier, b.id, b.financing_amount, a.write_off_state, case a.write_off_state when 'NO_WRITE_OFF' then 10 when 'WRITE_OFF_ING' then 20 when 'PART_WRITE_OFF' then 30 when 'WRITTEN_OFF' then 40 else 100 end as flow_sort_no, 'DEPOSIT_PAYMENT' as cash_flow_item, a.cash_flow_code, a.amount as plan_cash_flow_amount, null, null, null, c.duration_from as plan_cash_flow_date, c.id as financing_id, c.financing_code as financing_code, c.product_name as fund_channel, c.direct_financing_type as biz_type from fund_receipt_repay_cash_deposit as a inner join fund_receipt_repay_base_info as b on a.receipt_repay_id = b.id and b.financing_type = 'DIRECT' inner join fund_direct_financing_base_info as c on b.financing_id = c.id where a.deposit_cash_flow_type = 'DEPOSIT_PAYMENT' union select 0 as is_direct, concat('INDIRECT@', a.expense_type, '@', b.id, '@', a.id) as identifier, b.id, b.financing_amount, a.write_off_state, case a.write_off_state when 'NO_WRITE_OFF' then 10 when 'WRITE_OFF_ING' then 20 when 'PART_WRITE_OFF' then 30 when 'WRITTEN_OFF' then 40 else 100 end as flow_sort_no, a.expense_type as cash_flow_item, a.cash_flow_code, a.total_amount as plan_cash_flow_amount, null, null, null, ifnull(fee.pay_date, c.actual_loan_date) as plan_cash_flow_date, c.id as financing_id, c.financing_code as financing_code, org.organization_name as fund_channel, c.business_type as biz_type from fund_receipt_repay_expense as a inner join fund_receipt_repay_base_info as b on a.receipt_repay_id = b.id and b.financing_type is null inner join fund_financing_base_info as c on b.financing_id = c.id left join ( select a.financing_id,a.organization_id as organization_id from fund_financing_credit_ref a join (select min(id) min_id,financing_id from fund_financing_credit_ref group by financing_id) as minTable on minTable.min_id = a.id ) as ref on c.id = ref.financing_id left join fund_organization org on org.id = ref.organization_id left join fund_financing_fee_detail fee on fee.id = a.fee_id union select 1 as is_direct, concat('DIRECT@', a.expense_type, '@', b.id, '@', a.id) as identifier, b.id, b.financing_amount, a.write_off_state, case a.write_off_state when 'NO_WRITE_OFF' then 10 when 'WRITE_OFF_ING' then 20 when 'PART_WRITE_OFF' then 30 when 'WRITTEN_OFF' then 40 else 100 end as flow_sort_no, a.expense_type as cash_flow_item, a.cash_flow_code, a.total_amount as plan_cash_flow_amount, null, null, null, ifnull(fee.pay_date, c.duration_from) as plan_cash_flow_date, c.id as financing_id, c.financing_code as financing_code, c.product_name as fund_channel, c.direct_financing_type as biz_type from fund_receipt_repay_expense as a inner join fund_receipt_repay_base_info as b on a.receipt_repay_id = b.id and b.financing_type = 'DIRECT' inner join fund_direct_financing_base_info as c on b.financing_id = c.id left join fund_direct_financing_fee_detail fee on fee.id = a.direct_fee_id
